prompt: curl upload-file stdin non-blocking mode filename
answer:
Use a single period (`.`) with `--upload-file`/`-T`:

```bash
curl --upload-file . https://example.com/upload
```

`-T .` reads from standard input in non-blocking mode, allowing curl to read server output while stdin is being uploaded. A hyphen (`-`) also reads stdin, but the non-blocking behavior is specifically documented for `.`.
